gen.title: Atmosphere Layers from Surface Upward
gen.orderNote: Ordered from lowest altitude to highest altitude

steps.label: surface of the Earth
steps.quote: The Earth’s atmosphere is an extremely thin sheet of air extending from the surface of the Earth to the edge of space
steps.orderHint: begin at the base of the thin sheet

steps.label: three zones
steps.quote: The model has three zones with separate curve fits for the troposphere, the lower stratosphere, and the upper stratosphere.

steps.label: troposphere
steps.quote: The troposphere runs from the surface of the Earth to 36,152 feet.
steps.orderHint: lowest band where temperature falls with height

steps.label: lower stratosphere
steps.quote: The lower stratosphere runs from 36,152 feet to 82,345 feet.

steps.label: upper stratosphere
steps.quote: The upper stratosphere model is used for altitudes above 82,345 feet.
steps.orderHint: highest band where temperature rises again
